messages:
anna_support: Heads-up: customer PH-442 escalated — embeddings usage chart shows counts as "vectors" but billing shows tokens; looks like the console is double-counting usage. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal/links/IMG_1234.png
metrics-bot: ALERT: anomaly detected on embeddings_usage.hourly — spike +120% vs baseline.
anna_support: Repro steps:
1) Open Console -> Analytics -> Embeddings -> Usage (Daily)
2) Filter account PH-442, 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-07
3) Note 'Vectors' column = 2.4M and 'Tokens' column = 2.4M; billing.csv shows 4.8M total
mike_platform: I'll take it. Can you paste the query you used from the console (or time range+filters)?
anna_support: Query export attached (copied below):
```sql
SELECT account_id, date_trunc('day', ts) as day, sum(units) as total_units
FROM analytics.embeddings_events
LEFT JOIN analytics.embedding_requests USING (request_id)
WHERE account_id = 'PH-442' AND ts >= '2026-03-01' AND ts < '2026-03-08'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
anna_support: Customer says invoices include both 'vector_count' and 'token_count' rows for same request.
mike_platform: I think I see it — the JOIN above will duplicate rows if embeddings_events has multiple vectors per request. We should aggregate per request before joining. Quick fix: group by request_id first.
mike_platform: Proposed patch (hotfix): change pipeline step embeddings_aggregator to:
```sql
WITH per_req AS (
  SELECT request_id, sum(vector_count) as vectors, sum(token_count) as tokens
  FROM analytics.embeddings_events
  GROUP BY request_id
)
SELECT a.account_id, date_trunc('day', a.ts) day, sum(p.vectors) as vectors, sum(p.tokens) as tokens
FROM analytics.embedding_requests a
JOIN per_req p USING (request_id)
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
oliver_sre: Can we rollback the dashboard metric until backfill runs? Also need a backfill plan for last 90 days. Estimate: single-day backfill ~ 8m rows -> ~2 hours per day on analytic cluster.
jess_product: Need comms for affected customers and billing ops. @billing_ops can you freeze invoices for these accounts until we confirm corrected numbers?
billing_ops: On it. I'll mark PH-442 invoices as 'review' and pause auto-charge. Will need list of affected accounts.
anna_support: I'll pull list tonight and DM. Also adding internal incident (#INC-2026-0312).
mike_platform: Hotfix deployed to staging, rolling to prod in 5m. Starting backfill for last 7 days now. I'll post PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821
metrics-bot: NOTE: monitoring rule embeddings_usage.delta suppressed for 60m by @mike_platform
mike_platform: Backfill estimate update: 7 days -> ~12 hours. Running incremental to avoid throttling.
jess_product: Thanks team. After backfill, let's run reconciliations with billing for a sample set.
anna_support: Customer updated: they've paused usage and appreciate the quick response. I'll follow up with timeline.
mike_platform: All done: hotfix in prod, backfill started. Will follow up when complete. :white_check_mark:
